novedades.descripcion: Update web assets and refine UI components. Upgrade to version 1.0.26, incorporating refactored web implementations for core plugins (App, Filesystem, Auth) to enhance cross-platform stability. Additionally, adjust font size logic for user initials in the vault views to prevent overflow.
